component: Symmetric centring reserve starved a reading sheet at mid widths
explanation: CaissaTrainer Phase 2 (education.md E1). Observed: at 1180 the reading sheet was 372px wide and a PGN move list wrapped inside a 50px column, because the sheet cap subtracted the 300px rail on both sides to stay centered. Lesson: centring is a preference. A reading column gets a floor measure and centring yields to it; in a spread the column keeps all the remaining room. Relevant to the workspace pattern: equal reserve (candidate P23) must not shrink the region below its minimum (it already does not for the board, PRIMARY_MIN). Gap: no guidance says centring yields to a floor measure for reading columns.

classification.rationale: No rule on the relation between centring and a reading measure floor. Gap, small. Candidate: one sentence in the workspace pattern. Owner confirmation needed.
